about: v84q item power (Scott approved the power-notes design Nov 27 2026). Item Power = levelPower(ilvl) x rarityPower[tier] x awaken stagePower x budget. Power stats are multiplied by Item Power; utility stats only by utilityMul (their caps stay). Turn the whole system off with enabled:false or ?power=off (staging test flag).

levelPower.about: levelPower(L) = max(1, 1.045^(L-14)). Nothing changes at or below level 14 (Act 1). L30 = 2.02, L40 = 3.14, L50 = 4.88.

rarityPowerNote: Common..Epic stay 1.0 so Act 1 and early drops are unchanged (the design table had 0.8-0.96; changed so nothing gets weaker).
affixCountNote: Top-up target after the normal roll; 0 = leave the old roll (magic 1-2, rare 3-4). Limited by the affix groups that fit the slot.

monsterScale.about: Above level 14 monsters get hpGrowth^(L-14) life and dmgGrowth^(L-14) damage on top of hp + hpLvl*L (L50: x3.45 life, x2.43 damage). Gentler than item levelPower (1.045) because skill base damage does not scale with gear.

drops.about: Scott Nov 27 10:45 PM: the campaign ends mostly Elite/Epic with a rare lucky Legendary; more Legendary, then Fabled and Mythical, come from Ember Rifts and harder difficulty, scaled by rift tier and difficulty rather than monster level. Grades are rolled top-down (order); p = base + MF% x magicFind + the champion/elitePack/boss bump, then x ramp (campaign) or the rift formula (in a rift), then x the difficulty multiplier. Elite/rare/magic/unique/set come from data/difficulty.json drops; this adds epic, legendary, fabled, mythical.

ramp.about: campaign only: the chance grows linearly from 25% at the gate level to 100% at full

rift.about: In an Ember Rift of tier T (1-30) these replace the campaign chances for the top grades: p = per[g] x max(0, T - from[g] + 1), capped at max[g]; bosses x bossMul; champion/elite packs x packMul; MF adds magicFindMul x MF% x p. Epic in rifts: epicBase + epicPerTier x T.

difficulty.about: multiplier on the top grades by difficulty (campaign and rifts). White Ash opens a sliver of Fabled in the campaign (fabledCampaign) from mlvl 50.

starved.about: At 0 Hunger the item bites: 1% max life per second and it fights one stage lower until fed.

hunger.about: From stage 3 each awakened item has a Hunger bar that drains in combat and fills on kills. At 0 it is Starved: it bites for 1% max life a second (never below 1 life) and fights one stage lower until fed.

awaken.about: Awaken (v84q): items in the 4 main slots earn Ichor from kills while worn, then finish each stage at the Bench with a gate cost. Stage art 1..5 reads data/awaken-art.json (per item), falling back to the item's normal icon. Folds the old Consume slot in (Remnants kept).
stageLines: A hidden affix opens, themed to what the item does.
Its signature effect is 50% stronger. It starts to hunger.
It grows into its power (x3.1 item power).
It moves on its own: Mimic Strike.

sleep.about: Put a stage-5 item to sleep for good: it leaves a Remnant (data/consume.json remnantMul) on the hero and goes back to Dormant, locked.

endgame.about: v84q Ember Rift ladder (DESIGN.md 2d): 30 tiers. Monster life x riftTierHp^T and damage x riftTierDmg^T on top of the level scale; the rift's monster level is riftMlvl.base + perTier x T, capped at riftMlvl.max so item levels stay in the campaign's range (power comes from the tier, not from ilvl). Bosses every bossEvery tiers (the 3 rift bosses cycle past T12). difficultyAdd replaces the Kindled / White Ash life and damage multipliers (data/content.json difficulties) while power is on.

statsNote: Attributes are utility (not Item Power): they already feed damage, life and crit through the class rates, so scaling them by Item Power would compound.

crafting.about: v84q Bench crafting (power-notes/DESIGN.md 2c, js/ab-forge.js). Every forge action spends Temper from the item (data/ui.json leui.temperSpend:true); at 0 the item is Set and can't be worked. Materials sit in the hero's wallet (player.craftMats, no bag space). Crafting XP comes from every Bench action; levels gate Hone T6/T7, Rank Up to Mythical and Awaken stages 4-5. Uniques and set pieces have no Temper: only the unique range reroll works on them (costs no Temper).

ember_dust.name: Ember Dust
ember_dust.about: Salvaged from Common and Magic gear.

cinder_glass.name: Cinder Glass
cinder_glass.about: Salvaged from Rare, Elite and Epic gear.

ichor_shard.name: Ichor Shards
ichor_shard.about: Salvaged from Legendary and better gear and uniques.

rank_stone_1.name: Rank Stone I
rank_stone_1.about: Raises an item to Rare, Elite or Epic.

salvage.about: Salvage destroys the item (not worn, not locked) for materials. Runes in its sockets come back first.

hone.about: Raise one affix one tier (T1-T7). If its group has a bigger affix the item level allows, it becomes that one; otherwise its numbers grow by stepPct (15%) of the pool values per hone. Capped by the item level's tier; T6/T7 need crafting level 4/6.

reforge.about: Reroll one affix into a different one the item can roll (same prefix/suffix side).

imbue.about: Add an affix, up to maxAffixes for the rank (Magic 2, Rare/Elite/Epic 4, Legendary/Fabled 5, Mythical 6).

rankUp.about: +1 rank with a Rank Stone and gold. A miss still spends the stone, the gold and some Temper, and keeps the item. Normal items only (uniques and sets keep their rank).

sockets.about: Punch adds one socket up to the base's max; Seal removes one empty socket. So you can make an exact count for a runeword. Not on uniques, sets or finished runewords.

uniqueReroll.about: Reroll one of a unique's ranged stats inside its range (js/ab-uroll.js). Uniques have no Temper, so this costs only materials.

level.about: Crafting XP from every Bench action (awaken 8). xpToLevel[n] is the total XP for level n.

runewords.about: v84q runeword overhaul (power-notes/DESIGN.md 2e, js/ab-runes.js). Word stats (and rune stats in sockets) scale with the base's Item Power (js/ab-power.js). Normal words awaken to stage 3 at most (Fabled); Elder words (4 sockets, Elder runes Kel/Mor/Ost/Vael T9-12) may go on Mythical bases to stage 5. A runeword keeps its base's affixes but loses affixLoss affix slots for imbue.
runewords.how: Put runes in a socketed item in the right order. The item needs exactly as many sockets as the word has runes, and the right slot. Runes can always be taken back out.

where.upgrade: or 3 of the rune below at the Bench box

firstWord.title: A first word
firstWord.offer: Two runes and a knife with two holes. Put An first, then Bri. That spells Saltedge.
firstWord.done: You spelled your first word. The book has more of them.
firstWord.track: Put An, then Bri, in the 2-socket Ashwood Knife (Bench > Sockets).

socketTab.label: Sockets
socketTab.help: Tap a rune to put it in the next empty socket. Runes can always be taken back out.

runewords.firstSetToast: You hold every rune for {word}. Check the Runewords codex.
runewords.pinNote: Pinned: its runes and bases get a mark in your bag, and its runes drop twice as often.
